units: <cite ref="Chagigah 22b:16">Ḥag. 22ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>בית הצביטה</he>, <cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 3:1">ib. III, 1</cite>) <he>מקום שצוֹבְטוֹ</he> any part of a vessel by which you seize it.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 3:1">Ib.</cite> (<he>שותין</he>) <he>מקום שנקיי הרעת צוֹבְטִין</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>צובעין</he>; Ar. s. v. <he>בית הצביעה</he>: <he>שותין</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; Y. ib. III, 78ᵈ <he>שהנקיים תופסין בו</he>) that part of the vessel by which the cleanly seize it when drinking (under the rim); v. <cite ref="R00053"><he>צָבע</he> I</cite>.
